description: Pairs a place presence interval (derived from device samples) with a calendar entry whose time range lies within the interval, its outer bounds or a tolerance. A hypothesis for human review: a device at a place and a calendar entry at the same time do not show that the entry happened there or that the person attended.

criteria.inner_overlap_s: seconds of overlap between the calendar range [t_lo, max(t_end, t_hi)] and the interval's observed span [start, end]
criteria.inner_gap_s: smallest distance between both ranges (0 when they overlap); the gate is inner_gap_s <= tolerance_s
criteria.within_outer_bounds: the calendar range lies inside [outer_start, outer_end] (no sample of the stream contradicts presence)
criteria.location_text_contains_place_label: the calendar entry's LOCATION text contains the place label (NFKC + casefold); a text match is not a geocode
criteria.time_basis: basis of the calendar time from the timeline projection (explicit_offset, utc_epoch, assumed_zone)

probability: none: hypotheses carry per-criterion evidence only; acceptance is a human decision
